properties.name: template_columns
properties.comment: grid-template-columns: at most 10,000 tracks, `repeat()` counted; a list with `repeat(auto-fill | auto-fit, ...)` holds only fixed tracks (CSS Grid 7.2.3), else std::invalid_argument. A view onto the container style.
hand: a view onto style_.template_columns: write_view keeps the setter's check and invalidation

properties.name: template_rows
properties.comment: grid-template-rows: as template_columns. A view onto the container style.
hand: a view onto style_.template_rows: write_view keeps the setter's check and invalidation

properties.name: auto_flow
properties.comment: grid-auto-flow: row or column, sparse or dense (else std::invalid_argument). A view onto the container style.
hand: a view onto style_.auto_flow: write_view keeps the setter's check and invalidation

properties.name: justify_content
properties.comment: justify-content: normal, stretch, start, end, flex-start, flex-end, center and the three space distributions (else std::invalid_argument).
prepare: if (!admitted_content_alignment(incoming)) throw std::invalid_argument("GridPanel justify-content admits no such value");

properties.name: align_content
prepare: if (!admitted_content_alignment(incoming)) throw std::invalid_argument("GridPanel align-content admits no such value");

properties.name: justify_items
properties.comment: justify-items: normal and stretch stretch an auto-sized item; start, end, flex-start, flex-end, center and baseline (as start) (else std::invalid_argument).
prepare: if (!admitted_items_alignment(incoming)) throw std::invalid_argument("GridPanel justify-items admits no such value");

properties.name: align_items
properties.comment: align-items: normal and stretch stretch an auto-sized item; start, end, flex-start, flex-end, center and baseline (first-baseline alignment across a row) (else std::invalid_argument).
prepare: if (!admitted_items_alignment(incoming)) throw std::invalid_argument("GridPanel align-items admits no such value");

properties.name: row_gap
properties.comment: row-gap; a percentage is of the content box's height, and zero when that is indefinite. Finite and nonnegative (else std::invalid_argument).
prepare: if (!admitted_length(incoming)) throw std::invalid_argument("GridPanel row gap must be finite and nonnegative");

properties.name: column_gap
properties.comment: column-gap; a percentage is of the content box's width, and zero when that is indefinite. Finite and nonnegative (else std::invalid_argument).
prepare: if (!admitted_length(incoming)) throw std::invalid_argument("GridPanel column gap must be finite and nonnegative");
